description: Synthetic sesslint.scan-report.v1 schema parity. Constraints and expected rejections come from the pinned schema. Documents are hand-built. ScanReport.to_dict is not executed. No session text is stored.
known_parity_gaps: Schema loading and the ALL_CODES enum lockstep are not this validator.
Bucket sums, sorted reason keys, and reason sums are outside the pinned schema.
JSON round trip and skipped_reason_totals are emitter behavior.
Emitter omission of empty skipped_reasons is not one accepted object.
Duplicate JSON object keys are refused. Python json.loads keeps the last key.
A JSON number is an integer only when it is a proven i128.
